Montreal Canadiens defeat Toronto Maple Leafs in exhibition game

The Montreal Canadiens defeated the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-1 in a split-squad game. This marked the professional debut for Gavin McKenna, Toronto's No. 1 pick.
